chart.name: IIS files sent and received / sec
chart.programText:
A = data('web_service.files_received_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='A')
B = data('web_service.files_sent_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='B')

chart.name: IIS users / sec
chart.programText:
A = data('web_service.anonymous_users_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('web_service.nonanonymous_users_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Bytes sent+received/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('web_service.bytes_received_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='A')
C = data('web_service.bytes_sent_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='C')
D = (A+C).publish(label='D', enable=False)

chart.name: Requests / sec
chart.programText:
A = data('web_service.post_requests_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='A')
B = data('web_service.get_requests_sec', filter=(not filter('instance', '_total'))).mean(by=['host', 'instance']).publish(label='B')
C = (A+B).publish(label='C', enable=False)

chart.name: IIS total bytes transferred/ min
chart.programText:
A = data('web_service.bytes_sent_sec', filter=filter('instance', '_total')).sum().mean(over='1m').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('web_service.bytes_received_sec', filter=filter('instance', '_total')).sum().mean(over='1m').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).scale(60).publish(label='C')
